metadata.short_desc: Reminds you when Genshin / HSR / ZZZ / Arknights / Endfield dailies are not finished
metadata.desc: AstrBot plugin ported from ResinLoop. Tracks daily tasks in Genshin Impact, Honkai: Star Rail, Zenless Zone Zero, Arknights and Endfield; alerts only when something is left undone, with resin overflow and ending-event warnings. Accounts are isolated per user. Read-only: no check-in, no rewards.

push_targets.hint: Per-user subscriptions replaced this; only used by /daily claim

accounts.hint: Each user binds their own via /daily login; this is only for migrating old configs

resource_thresholds.hint: Alert when current >= threshold; 0 disables the alert for that game

webhooks.hint: Fill only the channels you use; empty channels are skipped

push_scope.hint: private_first: private chat if known, so group members never see each other's accounts

max_login_sessions.hint: Keeps multiple users from blocking each other
